title: Hotel Front Desk English Workbook for Beginners (A1–A2) – Printable ESL PDF
description: A 35-page printable PDF workbook of front desk English for hotel, guesthouse, and hostel staff at CEFR A1–A2. 6 units cover greetings, check-in, facilities, guest requests, complaints, and check-out. Includes cut-out role-play cards, a vocabulary list, an answer key, and teacher notes. Good for self-study or ESL classes. A4 and US Letter sizes. Instant download.

title: Front Desk English Role-Play Cards – Printable Hotel ESL Speaking Practice
description: Cut-out role-play cards for hotel front desk English at A1–A2. Each of the 6 units has 2 scenarios with a staff card and a guest card, plus useful phrases, so learners can practice what they say to guests. Study alone by saying both parts, or use them in an ESL class. Part of a 35-page workbook with an answer key and teacher notes. PDF in A4 and US Letter. Instant download.

title: Printable Hotel English Worksheets for Front Desk Staff – What's Inside
description: What's inside: 6 units with 24 worksheets (picture match, dialogue gap-fill, cut-out role-play cards, respond and write with an 'I can' check), a key vocabulary list, a phone and polite English page with a spelling alphabet, 6 pages of answers and teacher notes, and a progress check. For A1–A2 adult learners who work at a hotel front desk, and their teachers. 35-page PDF, A4 and US Letter. Instant download.
